profit_question: Can I make the protocol believe inventory is worth more or less than it really is for one transaction?

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H1: Flash loan self-trade on CLOB → AMM reads distorted state
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: CLOB and AMM pool types use independent pricing. No shared state to distort.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H2: snapPrice in addLiquidity allows arbitrary price movement → sandwich
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: snapPrice is bounded by tick range and available liquidity. Cannot move price arbitrarily.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H3: SingleProviderPoolType trusts external pricing hook → oracle spoof
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: Hook price validated MIN_SQRT_RATIO <= price < MAX_SQRT_RATIO. Output bounded by reserves. Hook controlled by LP.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H4: Direct swap bypasses pricing bounds checked by hooks
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: directSwap uses same pool type interface as regular swaps. No pricing bypass.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H5-H8: Oracle/TWAP stale price or manipulation
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: N/A — LB-AMM has no TWAP oracle. SingleProviderPoolType fetches price from hook per-swap (line 323).

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: H9: Controlled hook returns fake sqrtPriceX96
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: Hook controlled by pool creator = sole LP. Attacker cannot change another pool's hook. Self-attack only.
Slippage checks enforced in AMMModule core. Cannot be bypassed from pool type level.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: C26: Cetus-style tick overflow to zero price
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: TickMath validates abs(tick) <= MAX_TICK. MIN_TICK gives MIN_SQRT_RATIO (not zero).

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: C27: Balancer rounding direction drain via 1-wei dust loop
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: All divisions round down for outputs. 1000-op dust drain test: pool balance never decreases.
Round-trip input→output→input always loses value (backIn <= amountIn). Fuzz-verified.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: C18: CLOB maker overpayment via rounding mismatch
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: CLOB mulDivRoundingUp >= SP mulDiv intentionally. Maker-favorable design, not vulnerability.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: C17: FeeHelper fee exceeds input amount
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: fee = mulDiv(input, feeBPS, 10000) <= input for all feeBPS <= 10000. Fuzz-verified.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: C6: FixedHelper add/remove liquidity round-trip profit
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: Round-trip gains at most 2 wei (rounding artifact). Not economically exploitable.

ruled_out_vectors.hypothesis: computeRatioX96 overflow bypass to zero price
ruled_out_vectors.ruling: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow (safe). TickMath bounds prevent zero price from reaching swap logic.
For same output, required input via reverse path <= original input + 2 wei rounding.
